acid-splash.name: Acid Splash
acid-splash.description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.

blade-ward.name: Blade Ward
blade-ward.description: You extend your hand and trace a pattern of interlocking lines with a finger. For the duration, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

booming-blade.name: Booming Blade
booming-blade.description: You raise your weapon and the sound of its blade hums loudly. On a hit, the target takes extra thunder damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. If the target moves more than 5 feet before the start of your next turn, it takes extra thunder damage.

chill-touch.name: Chill Touch
chill-touch.description: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand that reaches toward a creature. On a hit, the target takes necrotic damage and can't regain HP until the start of your next turn.

create-bonfire.name: Create Bonfire
create-bonfire.description: You create a bonfire at a point within range. Any creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw or take fire damage.

dancing-lights.name: Dancing Lights
dancing-lights.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus or wisp of will-o'-wisp)
dancing-lights.description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range. The lights appear as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs.

eldritch-blast.name: Eldritch Blast
eldritch-blast.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes force damage.

fire-bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire-bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. On a hit, the target takes fire damage.

green-flame-blade.name: Green-Flame Blade
green-flame-blade.description: You wield your weapon wreathed in green flame. On a hit, the target takes extra fire damage, and if a second creature is within 5 feet of the first, it also takes fire damage.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

light.name: Light
light.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)
light.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. The object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

mage-hand.name: Mage Hand
mage-hand.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. You can use the hand to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors, or pour out the contents of a vial.

mending.name: Mending
mending.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch. The damage can be broken anywhere in a rope, chain, cable, or similar object.

message.name: Message
message.components: V, S, M (a piece of copper wire)
message.description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target hears the message and can reply.

minor-illusion.name: Minor Illusion
minor-illusion.components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
minor-illusion.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

prestidigitation.name: Prestidigitation
prestidigitation.description: A minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice. You create one of several minor effects.

produce-flame.name: Produce Flame
produce-flame.description: A flicker of flame appears in your palm. The flame is harmles to you and sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

ray-of-frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray-of-frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature. On a hit, it takes cold damage and has its speed reduced.

resistance.name: Resistance
resistance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice.

sacred-flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred-flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take radiant damage.

shillelagh.name: Shillelagh
shillelagh.description: You make a wooden club or quarterstaff you are holding into a magic weapon. Your attacks with it use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength or Dexterity.

shocking-grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking-grasp.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock. If the target is wearing metal armor, it has disadvantage on any attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn.

spare-the-dying.name: Spare the Dying
spare-the-dying.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable.

thaumaturgy.name: Thaumaturgy
thaumaturgy.description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range.

thorn-whip.name: Thorn Whip
thorn-whip.components: V, S, M (a twig from a thorny plant)
thorn-whip.description: You create a thorny whip that strikes at a creature. On a hit, it takes piercing damage and pulls the target closer.

true-strike.name: True Strike
true-strike.description: You point at a creature in range and make a magical attack. You have advantage on the next attack roll you make against that creature.

vicious-mocking.name: Vicious Mockery
vicious-mocking.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments. The target must succeed on a Wisdom save or take psychic damage and have disadvantage on its next attack roll.

alarm.name: Alarm
alarm.components: V, S, M (a tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire)
alarm.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range.

animal-friendship.name: Animal Friendship
animal-friendship.components: V, S, M (a piece of food)
animal-friendship.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm.

armor-of-agathys.name: Armor of Agathys
armor-of-agathys.components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury)
armor-of-agathys.description: A magical armor forms around you. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, the attacker takes cold damage.

arms-of-hadara.name: Arms of Hadara
arms-of-hadara.components: V, S, M (a tentacle from a twilight spawn)
arms-of-hadara.description: Black tentacles sprout from your body. When a creature enters the area, it must succeed on a Strength save or take bludgeoning damage.

bane.name: Bane
bane.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
bane.description: Up to three creatures you can see must make Charisma saves. On a failed save, the target has a penalty on checks and saves.

bless.name: Bless
bless.components: V, S, M (a sprinkling of holy water)
bless.description: You bless up to three creatures. Each target gains a bonus to attacks and saves.

burning-hands.name: Burning Hands
burning-hands.description: As you hold your hands together, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity save.

charm-person.name: Charm Person
charm-person.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid. It must make a Wisdom save with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it.

chromatic-orb.name: Chromatic Orb
chromatic-orb.components: V, S, M (a gem worth at least 50 gp)
chromatic-orb.description: You hurl a 4-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature. On a hit, the target takes force damage.

color-spray.name: Color Spray
color-spray.components: V, S, M (a pinch of powder of different colors)
color-spray.description: A dazzling array of colored light flashes from your hand. Creatures in the area must make Intelligence saves.

comprehend-languages.name: Comprehend Languages
comprehend-languages.components: V, S, M (a pinch of soot and salt)
comprehend-languages.description: You understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear. You also understand any written language you see.

contact-other-plane.name: Contact Other Plane
contact-other-plane.description: You mentally contact a demiplanes, an elemental plane, or similar plane. You can ask up to five questions.

create-or-destroy-water.name: Create or Destroy Water
create-or-destroy-water.components: V, S, M (a drop of water if creating or a pinch of dust if destroying)
create-or-destroy-water.description: You either create or destroy water.

cure-wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure-wounds.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

detect-magic.name: Detect Magic
detect-magic.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

detect-poison-and-disease.name: Detect Poison and Disease
detect-poison-and-disease.description: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet.

detect-evil-and-good.name: Detect Evil and Good
detect-evil-and-good.description: For the duration, you know if any aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead is present within 30 feet.

disguise-self.name: Disguise Self
disguise-self.description: You make yourself look different. You can seem up to 1 foot shorter or taller.

echoing-blast.name: Echoing Blast
echoing-blast.description: You emit a magical tone that only you can hear. A creature of your choice must make a Constitution save or take thunder damage.

expeditious-retreat.name: Expeditious Retreat
expeditious-retreat.description: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. Your speed doubles.

false-life.name: False Life
false-life.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood)
false-life.description: You bolster yourself with a necrotic approximation of life. You gain 1d4 + 3 temporary hit points.

faerie-fire.name: Faerie Fire
faerie-fire.description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light.

feather-fall.name: Feather Fall
feather-fall.components: V, M (a small feather or piece of down)
feather-fall.description: When you or a creature within range falls, the fall ends. The target takes no falling damage.

floating-disk.name: Floating Disk
floating-disk.components: V, S, M (a drop of mercury)
floating-disk.description: This spell creates a hovering, transitory disk of force.

fog-cloud.name: Fog Cloud
fog-cloud.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range.

goodberry.name: Goodberry
goodberry.components: V, S, M (a sprig of mistletoe)
goodberry.description: Up to ten berries appear in your hand. Each berry provides 1 hit point and nutrition for one day.

grease.name: Grease
grease.components: V, S, M (a bit of pork rind or butter)
grease.description: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square. Creatures moving across it must succeed on a Dexterity save or fall prone.

guiding-bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding-bolt.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature. The target takes radiant damage and sheds bright light.

healing-word.name: Healing Word
healing-word.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points.

heroism.name: Heroism
heroism.description: A willing creature is imbued with bravery. The creature is immune to being frightened.

hex.name: Hex
hex.components: V, S, M (the weapon of a injured creature)
hex.description: You mark a creature and cause painful wounds. The target takes extra necrotic damage when you attack it.

identify.name: Identify
identify.components: V, S, M (a pearl worth at least 100 gp and an owl feather)
identify.description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell.

inflict-wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict-wounds.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature. On a hit, the target takes necrotic damage.

jump.name: Jump
jump.description: You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled for the duration.

longstrider.name: Longstrider
longstrider.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)
longstrider.description: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet for the duration.

magic-missile.name: Magic Missile
magic-missile.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature you choose.

protection-from-evil-and-good.name: Protection from Evil and Good
protection-from-evil-and-good.components: V, S, M (holy water or powdered silver and iron)
protection-from-evil-and-good.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures.

purify-food-and-drink.name: Purify Food and Drink
purify-food-and-drink.description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot radius is made pure and free of poison.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.description: You ward a creature within range. Any creature that makes a melee attack against the warded creature must make a Wisdom save.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears to protect you. You gain a +5 bonus to AC.

shield-of-faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield-of-faith.components: V, S, M (a small parchment with a fragment of any of the three holy texts)
shield-of-faith.description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC.

silent-image.name: Silent Image
silent-image.components: V, S, M (a bit of fleece)
silent-image.description: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.components: V, S, M (a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket)
sleep.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect.

speak-with-animals.name: Speak with Animals
speak-with-animals.description: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube must make a Constitution save.

unseen-servant.name: Unseen Servant
unseen-servant.components: V, S, M (a piece of string and wood)
unseen-servant.description: You create an invisible, mindless, incorporeal force to perform simple tasks.

witch-bolt.name: Witch Bolt
witch-bolt.components: V, S, M (a twig from a tree that has been struck by lightning)
witch-bolt.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature. On a hit, it takes initial damage and ongoing damage.
